# P27.1 — Public-surface data & rights audit → launch-scope memo (LAUNCH.1)

## Summary

First ticket of the P27 public-launch chain. A **read-only** audit that measures exactly what a
national public surface can honestly show — publishable fraction, geolocated inventory, jurisdiction
spread, and the modeling gap — deterministically over **any** spine, and **freezes the per-page data
contracts** the rest of P27 emits (P27.4) and consumes (P27.5). No product code beyond the audit verb
+ docs. NO spine writes, NO source flips, NO publication, NO gate ticked.

Implements `docs/tickets/P27.1__public-surface-audit.md`
(`implement-spec spec=… live_verification=true`).

## What changed

- **`exports/src/exports/audit.py` (new)** — the audit engine: a read-only SQL query set (`QUERIES`),
  a pure assembler (`build_spine_audit`, unit-testable with no DB), a live executor (`run_audit`, puts
  the session in `default_transaction_read_only = on`), and `SpineAudit.to_json()/to_markdown()`. Every
  count is a `Fraction` carrying its **named denominator** (§32/SIG-METRIC-008 — never a bare total).
  Coordinates are reported **only in aggregate** (distinct-subject count + coarse jurisdiction label);
  no per-person/plate/raw-coordinate field (Part VIII §0.7 / §19.4 / §43.3). `redact_dsn` keeps secrets
  out of the report.
- **`exports/src/exports/cli.py`** — `sig-exports audit --dsn … [--as-of --note --json-out
  --markdown-out --format]`. Password is never on the command line: libpq reads `PGPASSWORD`.
- **`docs/build/reports/PUBLIC_SURFACE_AUDIT.md` (new)** — the live **as-of snapshot** (provisional,
  OSM land in flight) + exact queries + caveats + the **launch-scope memo** (deliverable 4).
- **`docs/build/reports/public_surface_contracts.schema.json` + `PUBLIC_SURFACE_DATA_CONTRACTS.md`
  (new)** — the **frozen per-page data contracts** for all ten public surfaces (deliverable 3).
- **`docs/build/reports/public_surface_audit.json` (new)** — the deterministic machine artifact.
- Tests: `tests/exports/test_audit.py` (12), `tests/exports/test_public_surface_contracts.py` (6),
  `tests/db/test_audit_spine.py` (2, Docker-gated seeded spine).

## Design decisions

- **The verb is the durable deliverable; the numbers are a snapshot.** The audit is deterministic and
  re-runnable over any spine. The live counts are an explicit **as-of** snapshot, never a settled launch
  total.
- **Provisional, per the concurrent OSM land.** A hosted OSM land (`camreg_osm_surveillance`, ~1.37M
  claims; D-SOURCES.17-1) is running concurrently, growing the spine ~1.06M → ~2.43M. The report and the
  memo flag the numbers PROVISIONAL and require a **re-audit after the land** — tracked as the new
  deferral **D-P27.1-1**.
- **Read-only, fail-closed.** `SET default_transaction_read_only = on` + SELECT-only; proven by
  `test_audit_does_not_write_to_the_spine` and the fake-connection statement guard.
- **No new ADR.** A read-only audit makes no new normative decision; the P27 cross-cutting decisions are
  already ADR-090…094.
- **Build-memory close in this PR.** The P27 seed (a6a2b56) already ran the coordinated MANIFEST pass
  (rows 117–125, nextTicket=P27.1), so the ticket's "coordinated pass after P26 lands" note is satisfied;
  per implement-spec Phase 6.5 this run advances LEDGER/BUILD_INDEX/DEFERRALS. `00_MANIFEST.md` is NOT
  edited (row 117 already present).
